correctness.rationale: The cited source supplies the nonstandard geometric input \(\operatorname{Aut}(X_W)\cong\operatorname{Stab}_{\operatorname{PGL}_3}(W)\), identifies the annihilator with a conic pencil, and states that the general pencil has four distinct base points in general position. Four such points impose four independent conditions on plane conics, so the pencil is exactly the full conic system through them. Its stabilizer therefore equals the setwise stabilizer of the base points. Four points in general position form a projective frame, whose setwise \(\operatorname{PGL}_3\)-stabilizer is \(S_4\) by simple transitivity on ordered frames. The included exact-symbolic script independently checks all 24 permutations in a normalized frame. No finite computation is used to infer genericity.
